summary: Declares the `blog` content collection's zod schema — the single source of truth for what frontmatter every post file must carry (title, description, lead, keywords, kicker, ogDescription, publishDate, readingTime, tags, next, optional wordCount). `publishDate` uses `z.coerce.date()` so a plain YAML date string parses to a real Date for sorting. `readingTime` is a free-text string with no computation or validation behind it — verified this session by computing word-count-vs-stated-minutes across all 10 posts, the unenforced convention in use is roughly 200-230 words/minute; a new post's value should be checked against a similar-length existing post, not eyeballed.
